text:
Pearls are typically found in mollusks, specifically oysters, clams, and mussels.

To enrich the artistic concept of the urban life exhibition, we can adapt elements from the hip-hop genre to the nature of pearls. Just as hip-hop transforms raw, gritty city sounds into rhythmic, structured beats, pearls represent the transformation of irritation or grit within a mollusk into something lustrous and valuable. The "flow" of hip-hop lyrics can mirror the concentric layers of nacre that build a pearl over time, suggesting that beauty and resilience are formed through persistent, layered experiences. The energetic, relentless pace of the city beats can be paralleled by the slow, steady, yet unyielding process of pearl formation, creating a metaphorical link between the chaotic energy of urban life and the quiet, enduring creation of natural beauty.
